queries: WITH timing_averages AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS group_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS baseline_avg FROM timing_averages) SELECT AVG(t.group_avg) AS mean_above_baseline, AVG(t.group_avg - b.baseline_avg) AS mean_excess FROM timing_averages AS t CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE t.group_avg > b.baseline_avg

WITH group_averages AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS group_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS baseline_avg FROM group_averages) SELECT AVG(g.group_avg) AS mean_above_baseline, AVG(g.group_avg - b.baseline_avg) AS mean_excess FROM group_averages AS g CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE g.group_avg > b.baseline_avg;

WITH timing_averages AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_instownpct FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_instownpct) AS value FROM timing_averages) SELECT AVG(t.avg_instownpct) AS mean_above_baseline, AVG(t.avg_instownpct - b.value) AS mean_excess FROM timing_averages AS t CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE t.avg_instownpct > b.value;
